text:
Asking rents in Kiel stand at a median of 11.27 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.8% on the year and +28.8% over five years. That ranks Kiel #21 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 48% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.64 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 676 € a month in cold rent, 16.2% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 23 days and 30% are gone within a week; with 1.6% market-active vacancy and +0.2% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 11.89 €/m² (+5.5%), with an 80% range of 11.61 to 12.14 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
